vb_textbox.text: In this game your given a choice between two seemingly random characters. At first you may be confused and click anyone short or small, colour or colourless. I found it best to start of randomly until you find the highest yield result anything above five. Once you find a knome that gives you give +7 on your next turn be sure to pick the same size knome or colour depending on the options available. If your rewards drop off be sure to change the knome you pick as it will change the longer you play.
